defines.comment: If the version saved in a file does not match this number, the portrait DNAs will get regenerated. Increase this number when making gene database changed that would break old portraits.
After this age, added life expectancy will make a character look younger than they are; the effect grows the further past this point one goes
This is the apparent age at which life expectancy stops slowing down visual aging (each year onwards ages you visually 1 year)
At this age portraits will use the special age gene at full strength
Default portrait animation, used as a fallback in places where portrait animations can be specified
Years in between portrait updating their current weight towards their target weight
Scalar for the liner interoplation of the weight update to trend current weight towards target weight
Min for starting random base weight inclusive
Max for starting random base weight inclusive
Characters that die at between -10 and 10 weight, and have no DNA generated, will get their weight set to 0 to save storage in the save game
When generating someone's portrait, generate up to this many generations of missing portraits
